name: USDT supply 50-day high long / 50-day low short
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: Daily Glassnode USDT supply makes a new 50-day high (supply > highest of previous 50 days) -> long the chart asset.
entry_short: Supply < lowest of previous 50 days -> short (optional).
exit: Close long (or reverse to short if enabled) when USDT supply makes a new 50-day low (below lowest of previous 50 days).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Requires on-chain supply feed (Glassnode) - data access cost may apply.
